metadata.notes: Idaho has 3 confirmed Library of Things programs. Community Library Network (North Idaho) lends games, tech, tools, and craft gadgets with a waiver. Creative Confluence Tool Library in Salmon has 217+ tools with $50/year membership for families. Ada Community Library (Boise area) lends outdoor gear, games, and wellness kits. Idaho Share & Supply (Boise nonprofit) was planned but their website appears to be down as of March 2026. Gizmo-CDA (Coeur d'Alene) lends STEM equipment to educators only.
